disclaimer: Domain knowledge, not legal advice. Confirm applicability per jurisdiction with a qualified reviewer.

items.name: General Data Protection Regulation
items.scope: Governs processing of personal data of EU/EEA individuals; drives data export, deletion, and residency features.
items.notes: Applies whenever a workspace's end users or customers include EU/EEA individuals, regardless of where the SaaS vendor is based.

items.name: California Consumer Privacy Act (as amended by CPRA)
items.version: Civil Code Title 1.81.5, as amended through 2025
items.scope: Grants California residents rights to know, delete, and opt out of the sale/sharing of their personal information.
items.notes: Applies once a business meets CCPA/CPRA revenue or data-volume thresholds and processes California residents' personal information.

items.name: SOC 2 Type II
items.version: 2017 TSC with revised points of focus, 2022
items.scope: An attestation of controls over security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and/or privacy, commonly required by enterprise B2B customers before they will buy.
items.notes: Citing SOC 2 criteria does not mean a product has passed an audit; an actual report requires an independent CPA firm engagement.

items.name: ISO/IEC 27001
items.scope: An information security management system (ISMS) standard, often requested by enterprise customers alongside or instead of SOC 2.
items.notes: Certification requires an accredited external audit; citing the standard does not imply certification.
